critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2052 lines — should be split into modules (auth, driver, trips, payments, fleet, admin, messages) for maintainability.
GET /admin/fleets driver_count query is O(N_fleets) sequential; acceptable for now but consider aggregation pipeline when fleets grow.
fleet_overview: 'created_at' comparison uses ISO string prefix which works for UTC ISO but is fragile if any legacy trips have differently formatted timestamps.

/messages/mark-seen accepts ANY trip_id without ownership check — a user could 'mark seen' another user's trip (harmless but not defensive). Consider verifying current user is a party to the trip before updating.

/admin/fleets POST auto-generates a random password for a new fleet_owner but returns nothing to admin about it — must_reset_password=True is set but there is no visible reset/email flow yet; document how the fleet_owner obtains initial credentials.
